Subject: Discovery Recap — Inference Cost Pressure / Next Steps

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our conversation and proposed next steps so we're all aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Unit economics: current per-API-call cost for real-time scoring is ~3–4x what your team expected; main concern is cost scaling with monthly active users.
- Latency SLO: 150–250ms p95 for customer-facing features (session-based personalization).
- Throughput: bursts to ~800 qps during peak periods; steady-state ~120 qps.
- Current stack: in-house model hosted on GKE with inference served on CPU-backed K8s nodes; experimenting with NVIDIA T4 GPUs in a sandbox.

What matters for success:
- 3x reduction in tokens/compute unit cost vs current setup while keeping p95 latency under 250ms.
- Ability to drop in a quantized model variant if quality impact is acceptable.
- Support for prefix caching and request-aware batching to reduce per-request cost without harming p95.

Technical notes (as discussed):
- You're open to model quantization (int8) for candidate endpoints if we can run a quick quality A/B on the personalization prompts.
- DevOps expressed concern about network egress and VPC peering; team would prefer Redwood Private or Dedicated as an option to avoid data exfil concerns.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive with your DevOps/ML infra team (30–45m) — dive into traffic patterns, token distribution, and current model size. (Target: Tue/Thu next week)
2) Redwood will share a short pricing/practical options deck and an SLA draft for Dedicated/Private (attached).
3) Optional: a 2-week pilot to measure cost per 1M tokens with batching/caching enabled against a baseline.

Attachments: redwood_inference_pricing_deck.pdf (pricing + pilot proposal), SLA-draft-Redwood-FinPay-v1.docx

If that all looks right, I'll get the deep-dive on the calendar. Any other stakeholders I should include?

—

Thanks Marissa — this looks accurate and very helpful.

A few clarifications and asks from our side:
- The 3x target is a hard goal for leadership; if pilot shows 2x we may still consider it but will need a clear roadmap to 3x.
- DevOps (cc'd) will want to see expected network egress numbers for Dedicated vs Private (we currently have strict egress reporting in GCP).
- We're happy to try quantized variants but need to keep an A/B test to monitor downstream metric (conversion rate) for at least 10k sessions.

For the deep-dive, Tue 2027-03-16 10:00am PT works for our infra lead — can you send a Zoom invite and an agenda? Please include Ben from your side if he'll be on the call.

Thanks,
